review:
A retro five-line jungle game, and one of Wazdan's calmest recent releases: low-medium volatility, a 96.22% RTP and a 1,500x max win.

No respins or collect symbols here. The big moment is filling the reels with matching symbols, after which a fortune wheel adds a multiplier of up to 15x. Otherwise it plays like a classic fruit slot with quick spins. Good for newcomers or anyone who wants something steady.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
